plotted_residual: actual Euclidean residual, not sqrt(n) times infinity residual
timing: Original baseline runs reused without changes. SCB confirmation runs are a separate serial batch with one BLAS thread, same30/60s caps, three repeats and rotating original/optimized order. Tables use medians; curves use the corresponding actual median-runtime trace. All initialization and solver work remain timed.
initialization: same constant minimum reward / (1-gamma), no extra shift

scb.inverse_model_representation: dense base plus all pending rank-one updates; BLAS3 flush; no truncation

igmres.tolerance: author code: GMRES rtol = alpha * ||initial policy residual||inf / ||policy reward||2
igmres.adaptations: max reward via negative costs; common vectorized MDP interface and dense/sparse storage; tol renamed rtol; common residual stopping and wall budget; scalar trace logging
igmres.replaces: all 96 provisional restart10 runs; none mixed

aa.fallback: .1*v+.9*T(v), exactly as authors experiment code (damped VI)
aa.source: Python port of cvxgrp/nonexp_global_aa1 codes/algorithms/alg_iter.m aa1-safe branch

qpi: existing equation-based Python reimplementations, not authors code; QPI-S rank/conditioning failures retained
success: all three repetitions pass; median of three timings only for successful triples; failures not dropped
original_batch_note: protocol.json records the initial batch; provisional restart10 iGMRES records are not final main-table runs

scb_implementation_selection.authorization: User requested the optimized version for every SCB curve and timing on 2026-10-11.

earlier_selection_superseded.rule: select cached implementation only if heldout geometric-mean median time ratio < .95 and all heldout runs pass
earlier_selection_superseded.selection_data: n256, seed131 only; no final-table instance
earlier_selection_superseded.parameters: identical H0, tau, theta, sigma, beta, forcing and budgets

scb_implementation_selection.statement: One implementation for all SCB instances; not per-instance or per-repeat winner selection.

scope: Main32-instance comparison only. Public Gymnasium supplementary experiments are outside this release; old standard-SCB supplemental timings are not mixed into the updated main tables.
